This plot is small, just under half a hectare, and beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they pull their own goodness from the soil. I have a little manure from the chickens and the goat that I will spread before planting, and I will use seed I saved from last season because the agro-dealer's improved bean seed costs too much for me. My husband and I will do most of the work ourselves; weeding twice is what beans need, and I cannot spare cash to hire people for such a small plot.
